$comment: Where the backend API docs (specs) are fetched from — the single COMMITTED source of truth read by scripts/lib/spec-source.mjs (sync-openapi, drift-check). `baseUrl` is the deployed public location; `urls` optionally pins individual spec files to absolute URLs when they live elsewhere (keys must match SPEC_FILES entries, e.g. "MQTT_Node.yaml"). For personal/staging overrides do NOT edit this file — create contracts/openapi/spec-source.local.json (gitignored, same shape plus optional `dir`) or use $OPENAPI_SOURCE_DIR / $OPENAPI_SOURCE_URL for one-off runs. Any override marks the run non-default: sync warns DO-NOT-COMMIT and drift-check treats the committed baseline as authoritative only when it came from this file.
